value.title: Governance writer and pij directory add
value.summary: Writer, resolver, refusals, pointer, ping pid, add and batch, docs, cost receipts, state flips.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Context brief. Purpose: the daemon-side community writer and `pij directory add` (AC2-AC10). Entrypoints: crates/daemon/src/http/governance.rs (argv family parser and handler, /v1/<family> routes in http/mod.rs Endpoint), crates/cli/src/governance.rs (native forwarding), orchestration/repo.rs (the git launch pattern via pij_core::program::launch plus spawns::record), crates/store/migrations (next is 0031), harness/scripts/government-root.sh (resolver to port). Order: tk-0001, tk-0002, tk-0005 and tk-0004 need no schemas; tk-0003 builds on 0001 and 0002; tk-0006 and tk-0007 wait for phase 1 (merge origin/plan/190-schemas); docs, cost, flips and gates close. Tests: real temporary git repos, git never mocked; ddocs injected through the constructor, one real-ddocs test with a named skip. Hazards: macOS git is an xcrun shim (count real launches); never the live governance branch or the prod daemon; ddocs resolves schemas from <worktree>/.dd, so copies live at the governance worktree root, not under .harness/government. Proof: bp-0002 to bp-0007.

value.title: Governance-root resolver in Rust
value.success: Port harness/scripts/government-root.sh to the daemon: from a repo, find the one standing prime-governance worktree and return its root and <root>/.harness/government. Every git call goes through pij_core::program::launch and records itself.
value.notes: No schema dependency. New module under crates/daemon/src/community/. Refusal code E-RS-GOV-ABSENT carries the script's bootstrap step.

value.title: ddocs resolution, validator port and doctor (C10)
value.success: Resolve ddocs once at daemon start from PIJ_DDOCS, else PATH, to an absolute path. A validator port (validate, build) is injected through the writer's constructor; the real one launches the resolved path via pij_core::program::launch and records itself.
value.notes: No schema dependency. Unit tests use a fake validator; one test runs the real ddocs and names its skip when absent.

value.title: Community layout and checkout-safe writer (C8, C9)
value.success: One layout module owns every community path (community/roles/<id>/role.dd.json, role.dd.md, memory/, outputs/; .dd/schemas/pij/* copies at the worktree root). The writer serialises per project, refuses foreign edits on its own paths, writes, validates, builds, then `git add -- <paths>` and `git commit --only -- <paths>` with seat trailers. Refreshes schema copies in the same commit when pij's version moves.
value.notes: Built against a placeholder document until phase 1 lands; the role parse is wired in the add task. Tests run against real temporary git repos, git never mocked.

value.title: Store pointer: migration 0031 and rebuild
value.success: Migration 0031 adds a community pointer table (project, repo-relative path, commit). Each write records its rows; a rebuild walks the governance branch head and restores the same rows.
value.notes: Migration number 0031 is claimed by pm-001 for this plan.

value.title: Ping reports the daemon pid
value.success: `pij-rs --json ping` carries data.pid from std::process::id(); no launch.
value.notes: Independent of everything else in the phase.

value.title: pij directory add, after merging phase 1
value.success: Merge origin/plan/190-schemas, then wire `pij directory add <id>` (fields as flags, or --file JSON) through /v1/directory to the writer. Appends one changelog row with the caller seat and --why; returns the commit sha and repo-relative path. Native pij-rs verb plus shim route.
value.notes: Blocked on phase 1 landing (pm-001 signals). Any schema change after that needs a docs-system verdict (C7).

value.title: Batch import, all or nothing
value.success: `pij directory add --batch <dir>` validates every role, then writes them in one commit; one invalid document commits none.
value.notes: Blocked on the add task. Eight fixtures shaped like the hand-written roles.

value.title: Docs: API, skill table, ping pid
value.success: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents the verb and its refusal codes and data.pid; skills/pij/SKILL.md CLI-verb table and the shim route table carry `directory`; docs/how/macos-defender.md (Measure launches) shows the pid.
value.notes: Shared docs; keep edits to the named sections.

value.title: Cost receipts on a private daemon
value.success: Before and after spawn readings with data.pid, the per-write launch count for one add and one eight-role batch, and spawn_sites.rs covering every new launch site; recorded in the backpressure cost row.
value.notes: Private daemon only, never the prod daemon.

value.title: Doc state flips and req-03 rewording
value.success: Roadmap s02 to shipped with plan cell set; req-03 reworded to C8; req-02, req-03 shipped; req-04, req-05, req-17, req-19 in-progress; c-role-schema, c-layout, c-writer shipped. Rebase after the s13 PR (191) merges.
value.notes: Biome-format any docs/project JSON after ddocs writes it.

value.title: Gates, PR and report to pm-001
value.success: `just rust-check` (scoped where possible), `harness checks`, open the PR against main, send pm-001 the PR number, head sha, checks result and bp-0005 readings.
value.notes: The job is not finished until the send has gone.

value.title: Writer enforces the standing_packet pairing (pm-001, from docs-system)
value.success: ddocs has no union type, so the writer refuses an inline packet without text or with a brief, and a brief packet without a brief or with text.

value.title: Biome-format PRD 001 after the phase 1 merge (pm-001)
value.success: PRD 001's JSON is Biome-formatted and still validates.

value.title: Review fixes F001 and F002 (#114, pij-still-termite)
value.success: F001: a standing packet's brief must be a readable file inside the governance worktree, checked before any write. F002: a PATH-found ddocs is kept as an absolute path.
value.notes: Verdict: pij-governance community/roles/reviewer/outputs/2026-11/pr-114-verdict.md. The reviewer's regression tests are kept in writer_tests.rs.

value.title: Security fix S1: no writes through symlinks (#114, pij-wary-lynx)
value.success: Every destination and its ancestors inside the governance worktree are checked with lstat, before anything is written and again just before each write; rollback restores only regular files.
value.notes: Report: pij-governance community/roles/security/outputs/2026-11-04-pr-114-d5fd8cf-security.md. F002 was confirmed by security too and is fixed in tk-000e.

tk-0001.assertion: In a scratch repo, the resolver returns the standing prime-governance worktree; with none, two, a detached one, a missing directory or no .harness/government it refuses E-RS-GOV-ABSENT with the bootstrap step government-root.sh prints, and writes nothing.
tk-0001.receipt: bc1fa86: cargo test -p pij-daemon --lib community::root (5 passed)

tk-0002.assertion: With PIJ_DDOCS unset and ddocs off PATH, or PIJ_DDOCS naming a non-executable file, a write refuses E-RS-DDOCS-MISSING with the install step and writes nothing; a document ddocs rejects refuses with ddocs' own message and commits nothing.
tk-0002.receipt: bc1fa86/d13abd3: community::ddocs tests (4 passed, real ddocs ran, no skip) and writer_tests a_document_ddocs_rejects...

tk-0002.assertion: `just doctor` prints the ddocs path the daemon resolved, or names it missing.
tk-0002.receipt: private daemon ping data.ddocs = the resolved path (evidence/phase-2.md); the doctor line's node parse checked on path, null, absent field and no daemon

tk-0003.assertion: In a governance worktree holding an unstaged edit to one tracked file, a staged edit to another and an untracked file, a write commits only its own paths; all three edits stay exactly as they were, and the checkout's next ordinary commit neither deletes nor reverts what pij wrote.
A path the writer is about to write that already carries a foreign edit (modified, staged or untracked) refuses by name and writes nothing.
Two concurrent writes for one project both land, one after the other; a held index.lock is retried briefly then refused by name, never forced.
When the schema copies under .dd/schemas/pij/ differ from pij's, the same commit refreshes them; when equal, they are not rewritten.

tk-0004.assertion: `cargo test -p pij-store` proves: deleting the pointer rows and rebuilding from the governance branch head gives the same rows, row for row.

tk-0005.assertion: A pij-daemon test asserts the health envelope's data.pid equals the daemon's own process id.

tk-0006.assertion: A private-daemon run of `pij-rs directory add` against a scratch repo writes, validates, builds and commits the role; the envelope carries sha and path; the changelog row names the caller and --why. Transcript in assets/evidence/.
tk-0006.receipt: evidence/private-run.txt: directory add auditor on a private daemon with real ddocs; envelope sha and path; changelog by the caller with --why

tk-0006.assertion: Adding an id that already exists refuses by name and leaves the branch and worktree unchanged.
skill_verb_coverage.rs and generation-skill-coverage.test.ts pass with `directory` added.
tk-0006.receipt: skill_verb_coverage.rs local pass; generation-skill-coverage.test.ts CI on ce95a06 (check (22), check (24) pass, run 41768186657)

tk-0007.assertion: Importing eight role fixtures lands as one commit; the same batch with one invalid document commits nothing and leaves the worktree as it was.
tk-0007.receipt: evidence/private-run.txt: import 8 roles in one commit; the spoiled batch refuses E-RS-DDOCS-INVALID and commits nothing; tests/directory_http.rs a_batch_is_one_commit_all_or_nothing

tk-0008.assertion: pij-rs-api.md and macos-defender.md show the verb, its refusals and data.pid; the skill coverage gates pass.
tk-0008.receipt: eee273b docs; skill coverage gates: Rust local, TS CI on ce95a06

tk-0009.assertion: bp-0005 carries before/after readings from one pid per pair, the per-write and per-batch launch counts, and spawn_sites.rs passes with the new sites.

tk-000a.assertion: `ddocs validate` is clean on PRD, blueprint and roadmap 001 with the flips applied after rebasing on 191.
tk-000a.receipt: 11db435: ddocs validate ok (0 error, 0 warn) on PRD, blueprint and roadmap 001 after merging main (191) at 23ba757

tk-000b.assertion: `just rust-check` and `harness checks` pass on the PR head; pm-001 has the PR number, head sha, checks and cost readings.
tk-000b.receipt: just rust-check local pass (1840/0); TS half of harness checks CI on ce95a06 (check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test pass); PR #114; pm-001 sent the PR, head, checks and cost readings

tk-000c.assertion: A role whose standing_packet source does not match its text or brief field refuses E-RS-ARG before anything is written.

tk-000d.assertion: `biome format --write docs/project/prds/001-pij-community.dd.json` changes nothing and `ddocs validate` is ok.
tk-000d.receipt: Already formatted upstream by e26e96e; after merge b8196da biome reported no fixes and ddocs validate is ok, so there was nothing to commit.

tk-000e.assertion: A batch holding a role whose brief is missing, outside the worktree, absolute, a directory or a symlink out of it refuses E-RS-ROLE-BRIEF-MISSING, naming the role and brief, and HEAD, the index and the worktree are unchanged; an existing brief lands.
tk-000e.receipt: writer_tests: a_brief_that_is_not_a_file_inside_the_worktree_refuses_the_whole_batch_before_writing, review_real_ddocs_missing_brief_refuses_entire_batch, review_real_ddocs_existing_brief_control; both fail with the check removed

tk-000e.assertion: A ddocs found through a relative (tools, ./tools) or empty PATH entry is kept as an absolute path and launches with the governance worktree as cwd.
tk-000e.receipt: ddocs tests: a_relative_or_empty_path_entry_resolves_absolutely_and_launches_from_another_cwd; fails with the absolutizing removed

tk-000f.assertion: A clean tracked symlink at the destination, at an ancestor directory, at the rendered .dd.md, at a schema copy or at .dd refuses E-RS-GOV-SYMLINK; HEAD, status and the link are unchanged and nothing is written outside the governance worktree.
tk-000f.receipt: writer_tests: a_dangling_tracked_symlink_at_the_destination_refuses_and_nothing_escapes, a_symlinked_ancestor_directory_refuses_and_nothing_escapes, a_symlinked_rendered_sibling_or_schema_copy_refuses_before_anything_is_written; all three fail with the check removed
